from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Party(BaseModel):
    """A legal party mentioned in the document with their procedural role."""
    name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the party (e.g., 上诉人，再审申请人)")
    role: str | None = Field(description="Procedural role in this case (e.g., Appellant, Applicant, Defendant)")

class CaseMetadata(BaseModel):
    """Specific identifying information about the case."""
    case_number: str | None = Field(description="Official case number (e.g., (2023) Xiang 0103 Min Chu 1234)")
    court_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the court hearing the case")
    case_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of case (e.g., 民事二审，刑事申诉，执行复议)")

class RulingDetail(BaseModel):
    """The substantive decision or disposition of the document."""
    main_outcome: str | None = Field(description="Core disposition (e.g., '驳回上诉，维持原判', '准许撤回上诉')")
    specific_changes: list[str] = Field(description="Specific modifications if any (e.g., '刑期由三年改为二年', '罚金减少至三万元')")
    costs_info: str | None = Field(description="Cost allocation details (e.g., '二审案件受理费 50 元，由...负担')")
    supporting_citations: list[str] = Field(description="Specific document numbers or regulations cited as basis for ruling (e.g., '粤公赔复决字 [2024]1 号')")
    quote: str = Field(description="Short verbatim excerpt of the ruling")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    parties: list[Party] = Field(description="List of parties involved in this document")
    case_metadata: list[CaseMetadata] = Field(description="Case identifiers and metadata")
    rulings: list[RulingDetail] = Field(description="List of rulings/dispositions found in the document")
